claims.claim: DistilBERT uses a triple training loss combining language modeling, distillation and cosine-distance losses.
claims.verification_note: Original scope is pretraining of smaller student, not just pruning teacher layers.

claims.claim: DistilBERT original student has six Transformer layers compared with twelve in BERT-base.
claims.verification_note: Do not infer universal GPU speedup from layer count.

claims.claim: Temperature softened logits are used in knowledge distillation; alignment reduction must match original implementation.
claims.verification_note: Tutorial T-squared KL is canonical generalized KD form; not asserting every code branch multiplies by T².

claims.claim: TinyBERT applies Transformer distillation at general pretraining and task-specific stages.
claims.verification_note: Stages have distinct distillation targets and training resources.

claims.claim: TinyBERT considers embedding, hidden states, attention matrices and prediction layer outputs as knowledge sources.
claims.verification_note: Alignment/projection is required when hidden dimensions differ.

claims.claim: TinyBERT compression/latency measurements are paper-configuration-specific GLUE experiments.
